svg.title: Figure 4 | The Library Analogy for Q, K and V
svg.desc: The three rows describe different roles. The library is an analogy; the model operates on vectors.

g.text: Figure 4 | The Library Analogy for Q, K and V
Q | Query: what am I looking for?
Like a reader carrying a query to compare with clues.
K | Key: what clues can be compared?
Like each book’s index information used to determine a match.
V | Value: what information is retrieved?
Like taking and combining content from books according to their
